'''Krugon''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Scout/Legends|scout]] who was active during the reign of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Krugon was a bald, [[Color/Legends|light-skinned]] individual who sported a red [[Hair/Legends|mustache]] and black eyebrows. They also had green colored [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. Krugon had a silver-colored marking on their [[Nose/Legends|nose]], and they wore a silver neck-guard. Krugon also made use of gray-colored [[Armor/Legends|body armor]], along with bluish-gray [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] and dark-colored pants. As a scout, they wielded weapons such as a [[Bryar pistol/Legends|Bryar pistol]] and an [[E-11 blaster rifle/Legends|E-11 blaster rifle]].<ref name="Sith">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Krugon first appeared in the [[1997]] [[Star Wars video games|computer game]] ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]'' as a character who only appeared in the game's multiplayer addition as a playable character model.<ref name="Jedi" /> They appeared again in ''Jedi Knight's'' expansion pack, ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]''. ''Mysteries of the Sith'' introduced "multiplayer personalities," a form of character creation that put different character models under different professions, with each profession being assigned their own set of starting weapons for a match. In the game, Krugon was categorized as a scout. Due to their multiplayer only appearances, Krugon's place in [[canon]] is uncertain.<ref name="Sith" />
